freeze.program: PM-0 through PM-7 and PM-L0 through PM-L5
freeze.reason: Consolidate, prove, and simplify the existing product before adding another top-level subsystem.

top_level_commands.reason: Expose the canonical six-verb orchestration facade without removing advanced commands.
Direct compatibility alias for saved-plan discussion through the facade.
Direct context-aware approval through the canonical facade.
Direct dependency-ready continuation through the durable runtime.
Direct canonical evidence closure through the facade.
Expose deterministic canonical report validation, rendering, and host presentation conformance.
Consolidate host selection, install/update, verification, diagnostics, and reload guidance behind the existing transactional lifecycle.
Provide one hash-pinned offline package and transactional project-payload upgrade path.
Expose package-owned trusted release discovery without inferring publication.
Expose one fail-closed aggregate of host, platform, and signed-publication evidence. Validation: python3 -m unittest tests.test_installation_experience.

mcp_tools.reason: Expose read-only semantic presentation conformance to MCP hosts.
Expose the same deterministic maintainability inventory through CLI and MCP.
Expose read-only coverage and claim-boundary reporting for the real evaluation portfolio.
Expose a read-only consolidated enterprise control and evidence-boundary report.
Expose read-only usability coverage, friction gates, safety posture, and evidence-backed wording/default recommendations without recording trials or changing product behavior.

schema_paths.reason: PM-1 requires one closed common result contract for transitions and explicit non-transitions.
PM-3 requires one canonical presentation contract shared by terminal, Markdown, host, and MCP surfaces.
PM-4 requires a deterministic registry, module-direction, budget, and documentation-owner inventory contract.
PM-5 requires a versioned multi-repository task and repetition protocol without representing fixtures as measured outcomes.
PM-6 requires one offline-verifiable enterprise control report with explicit hosted-evidence boundaries.
PM-L0 requires a closed, sealed inventory for canonical learning ownership, compatibility aliases, and non-destructive migration boundaries.
PM-L1 requires a closed append-only class, provenance, applicability, freshness, utility, privacy, and lifecycle contract.
PM-L2 requires a closed project-framed retrieval, applicability ranking, three-result cap, invalidator, contradiction, and explicit-use proposal contract.
PM-L3 requires a closed append-only use-decision, requirement attribution, evidence join, privacy, digest-chain, and capped observed-utility contract.
PM-L4 requires a closed append-only challenge, conflict, revalidation, repeated-rejection, privacy, and digest-chain governance contract.
PM-L5 requires a closed paired learning-on/control scenario catalog with later outcomes and claim boundaries.
PM-L5 requires a closed class-specific effectiveness, calibration, overhead, privacy, and claim report.
PM-L5 requires a closed project-framed, report-linked, bounded confidence projection.
PM-7 requires versioned cohorts, scenarios, numeric usability thresholds, safety boundaries, and evidence-based feedback signals.
PM-7 requires a closed privacy-safe, tamper-evident trial receipt for observed and fixture evidence.
PM-7 requires a closed aggregate report that fails closed on missing, insufficient, unsafe, or tampered evidence.
PM-7 requires approved, evidence-linked wording/default proposal and decision records without automatic source mutation.
Trusted release discovery requires a closed repository and verification-command contract without a publication claim.
The support gate requires a closed observed identity-verified publication receipt rather than workflow inference.

rules: Keep existing public commands as aliases while a canonical facade replaces them.
Announce deprecation before removal and name a replacement.
Preserve schema readers or provide a deterministic migration.
Do not change approval, evidence, privacy, or safety meaning through an alias.
Treat undocumented removals as freeze violations.

attestation.boundary: The committed baseline is integrity-sealed, not identity-signed. Organizational signing belongs to configured enterprise release attestation.
